pageProps.title: The Proof of Goo
pageProps.review: Choi Jin-young's novel 'The Proof of Goo' explores the most primitive form of love by depicting the memory and proof after death through the shocking act of cannibalism, combining love and taboo to the extreme.
pageProps.description: Here you are. I am with you, but you do not feel me.
pageProps.content:
## Review ```If you die first, I will eat you.``` I questioned the genre of this book as I started reading it. I didn't understand the introduction while reading. But as I went to the back, the content was clear.
An extreme combination of love and taboo, it expresses the act of ```remembering``` and proving after death through the somewhat shocking act of ```cannibalism```. Isn't this the most primitive method?
